Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday intensified his attack on the Congress over the shirtless protest staged during the India AI Impact Summit, accusing the party of converting a global platform into a stage for “dirty and naked politics”.
Congress spokesperson Dr. Pooja Tripathi, BJP's Rohan Gupta, and political analyst Badri Narayan took part in this debate on Youth Congress protest at the AI Impact Summit. BJP's Rohan Gupta condemned the act as an 'insult to 140 crore Indians.
